Name: DMC Sparda Mansion
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
[b]安装说明：[/b]解压后将文件拖入 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods > [/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW Custom Buildings All in One Pack[/url] 并选择“替换”[/i]
*替换前建议备份原文件﻿

[b]注意：[/b]
[list=1]
[*]建筑可视范围内皆会发生碰撞。虽然两侧有地砖，但无法步行/摆设装饰物。
[*]进门要站在大门的左侧。
[*]因建筑面积过大，安装该mod后你将不能使用其他皮肤的 HxW restaurant。
[*]如何解释老宅没有冬皮？就当是洁癖的Vergil和被迫勤快的Dante使用了魔力吧。
[/list]
感谢HimeTarts and Wildflourmods，这是我们目前找到的可能最贴合斯巴达老宅建筑内部空间的建筑模组。
仍然感谢 VegetaBul 和 Cotton_Spore 为重建老宅提供图纸。真是好大一个宅啊。

————————————————————————————————————————————

[b]Installation:[/b]
Extract and drag the files into: [i][i]Stardew Valley > Mods > [/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW Custom Buildings All in One Pack[/url] and select "replace"[/i][/i]
Backing up the original files before replacement is recommended.

[b]Note:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Collision applies to everything within the building’s visible area. Although there are floor tiles on both sides, you cannot walk on them or place decorations there.
[*]Stand on the left side of the door when entering.
[*]Due to the large building size, after installing this mod you will not be able to use other HxW restaurant skins.
[*]How to explain the mansion has no winter skin? Just consider that fastidious Vergil and the reluctantly diligent Dante are using magic.
[/list]
Thanks to [i]HimeTarts and Wildflourmods[/i], this is probably the building we found that best matches the interior space of the Sparda's mansion.
& Special thanks again to [i]VegetaBul and Cotton_Spore[/i] for providing the blueprints used to rebuild the mansion. What an enormous house...
